search_audit.outcome: Searched for an alternative after both packet Commons image URLs were excluded as failed. Inspected National Palace Museum, Met, and Princeton object records and direct image links. These provide reusable artifact photographs of oracle bones but do not identify a particular inscription as 見.

gaps: The inspected alternative artifact photographs have no record-level identification of the graph 見. They are therefore not included as selected historical glyph examples: doing so could falsely imply the character appears on the photographed object. The only inspected sources that directly identify 見 as oracle- or bronze-style glyph drawings are the Commons files already excluded because their direct image URLs returned 404. No eligible, directly identified glyph image with verified reuse provenance was established in this run.

limitations.text: No usable specific glyph candidate was established. Alternative museum artifact images are reusable but their records do not identify an inscription as 見; the two directly identified Commons glyph-image URLs returned 404 and are unavailable for this run.
